page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, eliminating hyperthreading overhead and ensuring predictable execution performance.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory density position this instance for enterprise workloads requiring predictable CPU performance and large memory footprints. The lack of local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators represents a tradeoff, making it less suitable for local high-IOPS database caching or deep learning workloads. It is best suited for large-scale memory-intensive applications, in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines.
